info.description: Milestone 11 backend contract: identity, sessions, access control, the authenticated customer profile, saved shipping addresses, and wishlist, the product catalog with customer-facing search, filtering, and direct product discounts, per-SKU inventory, the reservation lifecycle, and bundles, the authenticated customer cart, the configurable tax engine, the checkout calculation with the approved checkout destinations, the order and pre-order lifecycle with its immutable price and tax snapshots, the payment attempts, the verified provider event intake, and the refunds, the shipping destinations, the configurable shipping methods, the shipment lifecycle, and the returns, the customer reviews with their moderation, the customer notifications with their delivery record, and the administrative operations surface. Browsing is anonymous; catalog, inventory, tax, checkout, order, payment, shipping, review, notification, and administration require the administrator role.

tags.description: Liveness and readiness probes for the platform instance.
tags.name: Health

tags.description: Sign-in, the resolved principal, and the session lifecycle.
tags.name: Sessions

tags.description: Second-factor enrollment and verification for privileged accounts.
tags.name: Multi-factor

tags.description: Password change and the single-use reset flow.
tags.name: Passwords

tags.description: The authenticated customer's own profile, saved shipping addresses, and wishlist.
tags.name: Customers

tags.description: The authenticated customer's cart. A cart is an intent record, not a commitment: it holds no stock, creates no reservation, and performs no checkout.
tags.name: Cart

tags.description: The manually administered product catalog, its anonymous browsing surface with customer-facing search and filtering, the direct product discount and effective price, and the administrative routes that manage categories, brands, products, images, attributes, and sellable variants.
tags.name: Catalog

tags.description: Administrative per-SKU stock, the append-only stock-movement audit, the reservation lifecycle, and fixed and dynamic bundles. Every route requires the administrator role; no customer-facing cart, checkout, order, payment, or shipping endpoint exists.
tags.name: Inventory

tags.description: The configurable tax rules, the product tax classifications, and the administrative routes that manage them. A rate is configuration data scoped to an environment, never a hardcoded universal rate.
tags.name: Tax

tags.description: The checkout calculation and the approved checkout destinations. A quote is a calculation, not a commitment: it reserves no stock, creates no order, and takes no payment.
tags.name: Checkout

tags.description: The authenticated customer's orders and pre-orders, and the administrative visibility of them. An order stores an immutable snapshot of every figure the customer confirmed, holds its stock for a bounded window, and records every transition.
tags.name: Orders

tags.description: The payment attempts, the provider event intake, and the refunds. The only shipped provider is a non-production simulation that refuses to operate in production, so a production request can never collect money.
tags.name: Payments

tags.description: The administrative operations surface: the platform's operational picture, its customers, and its security trail. It is a read over the other capabilities' published contracts, and it owns no business rule.
tags.name: Administration

tags.description: The customer reviews of a product. A review may only be written by a customer who holds a paid order that contains the product, and every review is held for moderation before it is published.
tags.name: Reviews

tags.description: The customer messages the platform produced and their delivery record. The channel is not approved, so the only shipped providers are the local test transports and the transport that sends nothing.
tags.name: Notifications

tags.description: The shipping destinations, the configurable shipping methods, the shipment lifecycle with its tracking reference, and the returns with their restock and refund coordination. No shipping provider is activated: a method's amount is administrator configuration, a tracking reference is administrator text, and the model holds no delivery estimate.
tags.name: Shipping
